sources.limitations: the original pcapng files are not published (pnio-rs keeps only extracted hex); frame numbers refer to those unpublished files; the alarm frames come from another session than the start-up frames (CPU MAC ec:1c:5d:61:e7:3c instead of :3f); pnio-rs's cm-golden-frames.md swaps the two MAC addresses (the IP addresses in the frames are authoritative: CPU 172.16.2.100 sends from ec:1c:5d:61:e7:3f)
